title: Stehle anomaly: LESSON-019 caesar+columnar+route, BERLIN-only keyword
hypothesis_summary: Tightening of campaign-001 pack F3-31 (Stehle proponent). F3-31 used Caesar shift=5, width=4, and the keyword pool {BERLIN, CLOCK}. This pack drops CLOCK from the keyword pool — leaving BERLIN alone — because the Stehle interval-4 +5 segment DIAWINFBN at carved positions 55-63 sits adjacent to the BERLINCLOCK crib's left edge (63-73), so if the Stehle property and the BERLIN crib share a structural key the BERLIN side is the one with the closer positional anchor. The composition (caesar + columnar + route_boustrophedon) is preserved; only the columnar keyword pool is narrowed. Predicted side-effect: bean_passed=True must hold for any candidate that reaches a non-trivial crib_score, because the Bean constraint is variant-independent and crib-position-bound — a winning candidate cannot be cipher-class-correct without satisfying it. campaign_001_coverage: tightened.

provenance_items.quote_or_summary: Anomaly E0a: DIAWINFBN constant-difference property at carved positions 55-63; pairs 4 apart differ by 5 (mod 26). Bean 2021 §2.3, citing Stehle 2000.
BERLIN crib at positions 64-69 — adjacent to the Stehle window's right edge.

composition_templates.rationale: LESSON-019 numeric-Caesar + route_boustrophedon + keyed columnar with the Stehle parameters — same composition as F3-31, narrower keyword pool.

constraints: Single columnar keyword (BERLIN), single Caesar shift (5), single boustrophedon width (4). Hardest tightening of F3-31's parameter set without changing the composition family.
caveats: campaign_001_coverage: tightened. Strictly narrower than F3-31 (drops CLOCK from the columnar keyword pool, holding all other parameters fixed). Strictly different from F3-32 (which used Caesar alone, no columnar/route) and F3-33/34 (which used different shift/width assignments).

Predicted side-effect (Bean constraint behavior): a winning candidate MUST also have bean_passed=True. The Bean constraint is variant-independent and crib-position-bound, so a cipher-class-correct decrypt at the cribs implies Bean satisfaction. If a candidate reaches crib_score >= 12 with bean_passed=False, the side-effect prediction is FALSIFIED and the pack is ruled out without needing higher crib scores.

Pack passes if any candidate reaches crib_score >= 18 AND bean_passed=True. predeclared success criterion. If the audit produces crib_score >= 12 with bean_passed=False that is treated as side-effect FALSIFICATION even if no candidate reaches the success threshold.
Stehle E0a is locally measured at positions 55-63; extrapolating shift=5 to a global Caesar layer is structurally aggressive — confidence is set on the operation hint, not the anomaly itself.
